You do not need to fill in every box. Tell me what happened and I will ask if I need more.

**What were you trying to do?**
For example: install Script Glow, add an ElevenLabs key, get the built-in voices working.


**What happened instead?**
If a message appeared on screen, copy it here, or attach a screenshot by dragging the image into this box.


**Which computer are you on?**
Windows, Mac or Linux. If you know the version, say so. If not, that is fine.


**Which voice service were you setting up?**
Built-in voices, Chatterbox, ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google Gemini, or Ollama. Leave blank if you had not got that far.
